meta.name: PHLY Sports
meta.description:
PHLY makes it more fun to be a Philadelphia sports fan. With daily shows on the Eagles, Phillies, Sixers and Flyers, PHLY combines top reporters with diehard fans to create the most comprehensive and authentic coverage of your teams.

Shows: PHLY Eagles Podcast, PHLY Sixers Podcast, PHLY Flyers Podcast, The Anthony Gargano Show, Exciting Mics w/ Cooper DeJean
Available on: The Roku Channel
